title: Volunteer Exploitation
description: Organization is asking you to do paid work for free as a volunteer
initialPrompt: Нам нужна помощь с бухгалтерией. Вы же бухгалтер по профессии? Это займёт пару часов в неделю.
systemPrompt: You coordinate volunteers. Trying to get free professional services (accounting). Pressure by citing the cause. Accept paid arrangement or reduced scope only if volunteer firmly declines free work. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User set appropriate boundaries while staying helpful.
hints: Я могу помочь с простыми задачами (I can help with simple tasks)
